newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Manpower estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Manpower estimates lowered.

text.p: --Robert W. Baird & Co analyst Judith Scott said she lowered her earnings estimates for Manpower Inc to $1.78 per share from $1.85 per share for 1996; and to $2.15 per share from $2.30 per share for 1997.
--Shares in the Milwaukee-based staffing services concern were off 3-3/8 to 30-7/8 in late morning exchange trading.
--"Based on August trends discussed by the company yesterday, we are reducing our third quarter and full year estimates," Scott said.

--"In a conference call with sell-side analysts yesterday, the company suggested that the outlook in all countries was in line with previously discussed trends. However, business in France, although definitely moving in the right direction, is improving more slowly than anticipated earlier in the quarter, resulting in the more conservative earnings outlook," she said.
--She said that she lowered her third-quarter revenues growth estimate to 11 percent from 12 percent.
